commands.command: targeted additive048/multi-team/alert store and HTTP tests with -race

verifiedBehavior: Additive048 backfills the legacy primary team at project creation time and preserves all prior rows and receipts across reopen.
Composite organization foreign keys reject cross-organization project-team associations.
A project can retain multiple teams; attach and detach are idempotent and never replace another association.
Organization, project and team readers expose deterministic complete association lists.
Team project counts use associations, team deletion repairs the primary mirror and team-email alerts expand across every project team.
